title: Gateway Configuration
description: Schema for gateway/config.json — the Go gateway provider and routing configuration.

listen_addr.description: Address the gateway listens on, e.g. '127.0.0.1:8080'.

brain_socket.description: Path to the Unix domain socket of the brain daemon, e.g. '/tmp/claude_brain.sock'.

request_timeout_s.description: Hard request timeout in seconds for upstream LLM calls.

base_url.description: Base URL for the provider's OpenAI-compatible API.

privacy_policy.description: zero_retention = no logging; internal = provider may log but no training; public_data_only = may train on prompts (e.g. Gemini free tier). The router enforces: public_data_only providers never receive repo code, diffs, or secrets.

models.description: Model IDs available on this provider.

KeyPool.description: One set of API keys from a SINGLE provider account. Multiple pools = multiple keys from the same account for load spreading only. Never keys from different accounts.

env_var.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key, e.g. 'GROQ_API_KEY_1'.

priority.description: Higher = preferred. Keys are tried in priority order.

strategy.description: Model selection strategy. thompson_sampling uses Beta posteriors from model_stats.

fallback_chain.description: Ordered list of provider names to try when primary is exhausted.

cooldown_base_s.description: Base cooldown duration in seconds after a 429.

github_models_fallback_only.description: When true, GitHub Models is used only as a last-resort interactive fallback, never in the rotation pool.

risky_command_patterns.description: Regex patterns for commands that trigger a Drex gate check.
